newsitem.title: USA: VIMRX gets rights to wound healing agent.
newsitem.headline: VIMRX gets rights to wound healing agent.

text.p: VIMRX Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday that it has acquired the exclusive, worldwide rights to develop a drug candidate which was created by OsteoArthritis Sciences Inc for wound healing indications.

For a cash payment of $300,000, VIMRX acquires worldwide marketing rights, issued patents and patent applications for the use of the agent designated as VM301 in wound healing, an approved Investigational New Drug Application (IND), and sufficient clinical supplies to permit VIMRX to conduct Phase I and Phase II clinical trials.
VIMRX said it will begin Phase I clinical trials in the summer of 1997, and, assuming satisfactory results, plans to initiate Phase II clinical studies before the end of the year.
VM301 will be studied for the treatment of both partial and full thickness wounds, including burns, surgical wounds, diabetic skin ulcers, and decubitus ulcers (bed sores).
The company said the agent has shown promising wound-healing activity in preclinical studies when applied topically.
